Each with its owner, basis, formats, its route (none for a report opened from a record) and whether it is pinned; the owners whose catalogue failed are named apart. No report runs.

service.description: Pin or unpin one catalog entry in the user's InsightsHome preference (design §3), at sequenceNum among the pins or at the end. Edits the preference only. Refuses an entry the user does not read (REPORT_UNAVAILABLE) and a stale expectedRevision (PINS_CHANGED).

The shared parameters an entry's route takes (its parameter contract), typed: the organization in scope and the user's choices, a default range, the organization's fiscal periods; the owner's own options when it registers an options service. Never runs the report. Refuses an entry the user does not read (REPORT_UNAVAILABLE) and an organization not the user's (ORGANIZATION_UNAVAILABLE).

service.description: The owner's route of an entry with only its contract's parameters, for ReportContext's Open. Refuses an entry the user does not read (REPORT_UNAVAILABLE), one opened from a record (REPORT_ROUTE_UNAVAILABLE) and an organization not the user's (ORGANIZATION_UNAVAILABLE).

A registered metric's descriptor (owner, version, grain, basis, aggregation, numerator and denominator, unit policy, dimensions, exclusions, scope, freshness and the comparison rules), by metricId or by the panel that names it (a library panel's definitionId, or a dashboard's definitionId and panelId, read as the user); with the panel's metric version, currency and target and, given value (and targetActual for a measure target), the comparison: a missing or zero target is unavailable. A panel without a measure answers available false. Refuses a metric not registered or not readable (METRIC_UNAVAILABLE).

Dashboard's MeasureMeaning (design §4): each panel of a dashboard (or a library panel) the user reads that names a registered measure, with its title and version, grain, basis, numerator over denominator for a rate, exclusions, the comparison rules, source and freshness; a measure not registered or not readable is said so. Refuses a definition that is not a dashboard or panel (DASHBOARD_REQUIRED); the engine refuses one the user may not read.
The registered metrics the user may read, for a panel's measure picker.

Attach a registered metric (its current version) to the user's own library panel, or clear it (no metricId); saved through the report engine as the user. Refuses a user without authoring (INSIGHTS_AUTHOR_REQUIRED), a definition that is not a panel (PANEL_REQUIRED) or not the user's (PANEL_NOT_OWNED) and an unregistered metric (METRIC_UNAVAILABLE); the engine refuses a stale expectedVersion.

A library panel's target (design §4 Target), exactly {panelId, targetKind, targetMetricId, targetValue, targetUnitId, periodBinding, betterDirection, expectedVersion}: a value target takes a value and its unit, a measure target a registered measure of the same unit and basis; a money target names one currency and the panel must be filtered to it. No targetKind clears the target. Refuses PANEL_MEASURE_REQUIRED, TARGET_KIND_INVALID, TARGET_INPUT_INVALID, TARGET_VALUE_REQUIRED, TARGET_METRIC_REQUIRED, TARGET_UNIT_MISMATCH, TARGET_CURRENCY_MIXED (mixed currencies) and the panel refusals of store#PanelMeasure.

The user's saved work by kind, kept apart: the report engine's dashboards, library panels, saved searches and playlists the user reads (theirs and shared with their groups; not the shipped ones), the saved finds (FormListFind) of the user and their groups, and the pinned catalog entries; each with owner, sharing, the route it opens or why not, and whether the user may save a copy. Filtered by kind (or definition), owner (mine or shared) and text.

service.description: The legacy mapping of design §13.2 (impl-insights P12), an instance administrator's (ADMIN_REQUIRED otherwise) deliberate upgrade step: the saved finds (FormListFind) of Insights' lists and the schedules (ScreenScheduled) of its screens, each by ID, owners, sharing and list or route, with what the mapping does: moved (its list or screen was replaced by a registered one: DatasetDetail/FieldList by DatasetFields, the copied scheduled finds' list by Scheduled reports' Schedules), kept, or invalid (its list is gone and nothing replaces it; SavedReports shows it as not valid). Without apply nothing is written; with apply the moved ones are rewritten. A find keeps its owners, groups and fields; a field the new list lacks is named (unknownFields). No alias route is added.

service.description: Save a copy of a definition the user reads (SaveAs): a new title, private or one of the user's own groups, through the report engine's save as the user. Refuses a user without authoring (INSIGHTS_AUTHOR_REQUIRED), no title (TITLE_REQUIRED), a group the user is not in (SHARE_GROUP_UNAVAILABLE), another kind of definition (COPY_UNAVAILABLE) and a stale expectedVersion (DEFINITION_CHANGED).

The user's Insights Home (design §3): the organization in scope (the requested one only when it is the user's, else the saved one, else their default) and the dashboard variables that keep the panels to it, the default range, their starred and recent dashboards they still read, the dashboard whose panels Home shows (their InsightsHome choice, else the shipped suite dashboard) with at most six panels in their order, the dashboards and panels they may arrange, their pinned reports they still read (the owners whose catalogue failed named apart) and whether this is their first use. Attention is get#Attention's. Refuses a user without Insights read (INSIGHTS_VIEW_REQUIRED) and an organization not theirs (ORGANIZATION_UNAVAILABLE).

service.description: The user's Home arrangement in their InsightsHome preference: the organization in scope, the dashboard whose panels Home shows (empty: the suite dashboard) and at most six of its panels in order. Edits the preference only; pins are kept. Refuses a stale expectedRevision (HOME_CHANGED), an organization not the user's (ORGANIZATION_UNAVAILABLE), a dashboard the user does not read (DASHBOARD_UNAVAILABLE) or that is not a dashboard (DASHBOARD_REQUIRED), a panel not on it (PANEL_UNAVAILABLE) and more than six panels (HOME_PANELS_LIMIT).

The attention board (design §3 Attention): each registered provider the user may read, its count from its owner's count service called as the user (the query of the worklist it opens), with the overdue part where the owner answers one and the worklist's route with its filter (and the organization in scope, for a provider that honors it), grouped by owner, never added into a total. A provider whose route does not open to the user, whose permission they lack, whose owner refuses them or answers them no count is left out; one whose count fails is a card saying so, and the others still answer. Filtered by ownerApp. Refuses a user without Insights read (INSIGHTS_VIEW_REQUIRED) and an organization not theirs (ORGANIZATION_UNAVAILABLE).

service.description: Monitor's Business operations dashboard as an attention source (impl-insights F19): the operation runs rolled back or set to retry over the last day (from: a relative start), counted by the shipped dashboard's own "Rollbacks and retries by operation" query, run as the user, so Monitor's grants (the dashboard and the telemetry dataset) decide. Refuses a user without Insights read (INSIGHTS_VIEW_REQUIRED); the report engine refuses one without the dataset.

Insights' data readiness (design §11 DataReadiness; impl-insights P10): the sources Insights registered in Admin's readiness registry that the user may read, through ironstone.admin.RegistryServices.get#Readiness as the user (its freshness facet: the last watermark, the expected frequency, the lag and the coverage), each with its domain owner and class and the freshness policy of the organization in scope applied: a ready source older than the policy allows is stale, with its lag. Stale, waiting for review, failed and unavailable stay apart; a provider that could not be checked is named and the others still answer; the registered refresh is offered only where Admin's registry says the user may run it. There is no second readiness registry. Filtered by domain owner, source and state. Refuses a user without Insights read (INSIGHTS_VIEW_REQUIRED) and an organization not theirs (ORGANIZATION_UNAVAILABLE); Admin's registry refuses one without its grant.

parameter.name: state
parameter.description: ready, stale, warning, failed or unavailable
